title: 2026-08-21-settlement-backfill-spec
universal_lens: Settlement backfill operates as a temporal ratchet under bounded score retrieval, where \( T_{\text{paid}} = 3 \) days constrains \( \mathcal{S}_{\text{paid}}(t) \) and \( \mathcal{S}_{\text{free}}(t) \) to prevent retroactive resolution of \( \mathcal{P}_{\text{pending}} \) picks.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference models \( \mathcal{P}(\text{settle} \mid \text{score}) \) over \( \mathcal{S}_{\text{paid}} \) and \( \mathcal{S}_{\text{free}} \), updating \( \mathcal{P}_{\text{pending}} \) with \( \mathcal{T}_{\text{backfill}} \) when \( t < T_{\text{paid}} \).
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning maps \( \mathcal{P}_{\text{pending}} \) to \( \mathcal{S}_{\text{free}} \) via \( \mathcal{T}_{\text{backfill}} \), transitioning states with \( \Delta \mathcal{S} \) and \( \Delta \mathcal{T} \) to resolve \( \mathcal{P}_{\text{unsettleable}} \).

reasoning_traces.think:
The core issue is a temporal ratchet caused by \( \mathcal{S}_{\text{paid}} \) limiting \( \mathcal{P}_{\text{pending}} \) resolution to \( T_{\text{paid}} = 3 \) days. When \( \text{commenceTime}(g) < t - T_{\text{paid}} \), \( g \) is permanently unsettleable. This creates a feedback loop where \( \mathcal{P}_{\text{overdue}} \) grows monotonically. The \( \mathcal{T}_{\text{backfill}} \) operator mitigates this by reusing \( \mathcal{S}_{\text{free}} \) to resolve \( \mathcal{P}_{\text{pending}} \) beyond \( T_{\text{paid}} \). The \( \mathcal{S}_{\text{free}} \) kernel ensures no additional cost while maintaining data integrity. The \( \mathcal{P}_{\text{unsettleable}} \) set is thus reduced through \( \mathcal{T}_{\text{backfill}} \).
